title: @xyz_to_ijk
description: Helper script to convert (x, y, z) coordinates to (i, j, k) indices for a volumetric dataset.

x_coord.description: Three coordinates (in units of the dataset, like mm)
x_coord.title: X coordinate

y_coord.description: Three coordinates (in units of the dataset, like mm)
y_coord.title: Y coordinate

z_coord.description: Three coordinates (in units of the dataset, like mm)
z_coord.title: Z coordinate

prefix.description: File name (including path) to output the three indices
prefix.title: Output prefix
